title: ActionSplice: In-Flight Action Editing for Interactive World Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.08230v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Chunk-autoregressive video world models typically condition each generated chunk on one action. An action received during sampling must therefore wait for the next chunk, condition future solver evaluations on a state produced under the previous action, or trigger rollback that repeats completed evaluations. We introduce ActionSplice, an inference framework that formulates this problem as Counterfactual State Transport (CST). A lightweight corrector transports the interrupted backbone-native representation toward the matched state induced by the revised action at the same solver step. The world model and sampler remain frozen, and sampling resumes without replaying completed evaluations. The retargeting variant $\mathrm{CST}*{R}$ updates the entire active chunk, while the temporal-splicing variant $\mathrm{CST}*{T}$ preserves a temporal prefix and updates only the suffix. translated_title: ActionSplice：面向交互式世界模型的即时动作编辑
translated_abstract: 分块自回归视频世界模型通常将每个生成的分块条件于一个动作之上。因此，在采样过程中接收到的动作必须等待下一个分块，或者使未来的求解器评估以在前一动作下产生的状态为条件，或者触发回滚并重复已完成的评估。我们提出了ActionSplice，一个将该问题形式化为反事实状态传输的推理框架。一个轻量级校正器在相同的求解器步骤处，将中断的主干原生表示向由修改后动作所诱导的匹配状态进行传输。世界模型和采样器保持冻结，采样在无需重放已完成评估的情况下得以恢复。重定向变体CST_R会更新整个活动分块，而时间拼接变体CST_T则保留时间前缀并仅更新后缀。在minWM-Wan Action2V和HY-WM1.5上，CST_R减少
tldr: ActionSplice提出了一种基于反事实状态传输的推理框架，使分块自回归世界模型能够在采样过程中即时修改动作，无需等待下一分块或触发代价高昂的回滚重算。
en_tdlr: ActionSplice introduces an inference framework based on Counterfactual State Transport that enables in-flight action editing for chunk-autoregressive world models, avoiding waits for the next chunk or costly rollback recomputation.
